::: {#exr-noise-twice}

#### Adding noise twice

Start from a data point $\vx_0$,
and add noise twice:

$$
\vx_1 = \sqrt{1 - \beta_1} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{\beta_1} \, \vnoise_1,
\qquad
\vx_2 = \sqrt{1 - \beta_2} \, \vx_1 + \sqrt{\beta_2} \, \vnoise_2,
$$

with $\vnoise_1$ and $\vnoise_2$ independent draws from $\dNf{\vzero, \idmat}$.
What is the distribution of $\vx_2$ given $\vx_0$?

:::
